body:
## Southeast University Programmers

In July 2024, I joined fellow programmers from Southeast University for a competitive programming meetup. These two group photographs capture the gathering and a moment in my programming journey.

Competitive programming is an important part of my development as a Computer Science and Engineering student. I enjoy tackling challenging problems, refining my approach to algorithms, and continuing to learn alongside other programmers.

## Moments from the Meetup

These photographs are a personal record of time spent with the Southeast University programming community.


## Key Takeaways (কী শিখলাম)

- **Collaborative Problem Deconstruction:** Learned how articulating logic out loud with peers exposes hidden assumptions and reveals elegant mathematical shortcuts.
- **Time Complexity Discipline:** Solidified the habit of calculating worst-case operations ($O(N \log N)$ vs $O(N^2)$) before typing a single line of implementation.
- **Structured Practice Roadmap:** Formulated a disciplined topic-wise practice plan covering number theory, binary search, and prefix sums to systematically eliminate weak spots.
